cohort: The study included 298 women, divided into groups with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, gestational diabetes mellitus, and a control group without diabetes, who underwent antenatal C-CTG monitoring.
finding: Fetal heart rate was statistically higher in pregnant women with pre-pregnancy diabetes (Type 1 and 2) compared to gestational diabetes and controls, while C-CTG parameters (STV, APRS, and DPRS) were statistically lower in the pre-pregnancy type 1 diabetes group.
cross-section timing: Antenatal monitoring at the time of outpatient admission
